title: Completion reports lost obligation projections before its named-root and source-change refusals
outcome: Completion reports lost obligation projections before its named-root and source-change refusals
acceptance: On a run with a named root whose source-change obligation lost its waiver row, completion refuses with InvalidWorkProjection naming the lost record, before any named-root or source-change refusal, and no resolution is appended; a test covers it
